title: Successor of a pure tensor in balanced scalar association coordinates
statement: Fix l,E,L,iota,W, coefficient-extension systems A, an ordinary quotient tensor model M, normalized finite scalar evaluations rho, and balanced finite associations as in [stage3-pur-extension-reduction-data], [def-trf-completion-unit-models], and [stage3-pur-scalar-cochain-evaluation]. Let a_n be the composite of rho after M.tensor, finite scalar extension of M.evaluation, and association. For every completed-E sheaf module K, n, U, coefficient b in the level n+1 L quotient over U, and x in K(U), the L-system successor applied to a_(n+1) inverse of b tensor x is HEq to a_n inverse of red(b) tensor x. This statement concerns local pure tensors only; extension to arbitrary sections is a separate tensor hom-ext argument.

proof.text: Use naturality of the finite scalar unit along M.evaluation and the balanced association formula at coefficient one. The inverse a_n of b tensor x equals b times the normalized finite scalar unit of q_n(x).
The normalized quotient units are successor compatible, and scalar unit naturality preserves this compatibility after scalar extension.

The successor is semilinear for the coefficient quotient. Apply map_smul to the inverse-coordinate formula; the normalized quotient map at a successor is the recorded coefficient reduction. Substitute the lower inverse-coordinate formula.

proof_origin.place: lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules (03D7), section-tensor-product (03EK); sequence site preceding sites-cohomology.tex 0941. Fully proved auxiliary calculation for stage3-pur-extension-association-successor.

theorem associatedTensor_transition
    (A : CoefficientExtensionSystems l E L ι W)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W)
    (ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, A.scalar.model.E ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n ≅
      coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E)
    (hρ : IsCoefficientScalarEvaluationUnit l E L ι W A ρ)
    (association : ∀ n : ℕ,
      scalarReductionExtension l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E ≅
        integralScalarReduction l E L ι W n)
    (hassociation : IsCoefficientExtensionAssociation l E L ι W A association)
    (K : scalarReductionSource l E W) (n : ℕ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (s₀ : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l L W (n + 1)).obj.obj U) (x : K.val.obj U) :
    let a (k : ℕ) := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft M.tensor (ρ k) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (M.evaluation k) (A.levels k).model.E ≪≫ association k
    HEq (((coefficientSequenceTransition l L W (Nat.le_succ n)).app
      (A.scalar.model.E.obj (M.tensor.obj K))).val.app U
      (((a (n + 1)).inv.app K).val.app U
        (integralScalarTensorSection l E L ι W (n + 1) K U s₀ x)))
      (((a n).inv.app K).val.app U (integralScalarTensorSection l E L ι W n K U
        ((integralCoefficientSheafTransition l L W n).hom.app U s₀) x))
